name: MedArc
summary:
MedArc is a space-based 2D hospital simulation game where you design, build, and manage your very own interstellar medical facility.

From humble beginnings to a fully operational space hospital, you'll need to plan your facilities, manage staff and resources, treat patients, and keep everything running smoothly in the challenging environment of deep space.

Build new departments, expand your hospital, and create an efficient facility capable of caring for patients from across the galaxy. But running a hospital isn't just about putting rooms together. You'll need to balance the needs of your patients, staff, and finances while dealing with the unexpected challenges that come with operating a hospital among the stars.

Design it. Build it. Run it.

Welcome to MedArc.
